name: supply-sophie-unanswered-round
narrative: Sophie runs RUTF procurement for the Connect-RUTF program, and on 15 September she asked six suppliers to quote round 2: half have never answered, despite two reminders, and she forwards whatever does arrive to an AI that records it. Sophie opens the round and reads who answered and who has said nothing, how long each has been silent and when she last chased them. She opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, sends it from her own mailbox, and records the chase from the draft. Sahel finally answers with a quote, and Sophie watches the record move: the AI has recorded it from the email, and Sahel is no longer silent. She finds Northgate's questions waiting on her and answers who will import. She opens the comparison and reads what each answer still lacks: Harmattan's quote states everything, Kanem's lacks its pack size, and Sahel's new one leaves out freight, duty and the exchange rate. On the round 1 order with Harmattan, she reads the forwarder's message that the trucks are held at the border on our import permit, finds the advance she paid before any invoice existed, and sees the invoice flagged as above the agreed price. Back on her overview, Sophie reads who is still silent and whose move each thing is.

sophie.intro: Sophie buys RUTF for the Connect-RUTF program; suppliers and the freight forwarder email her, and she forwards what they send to an AI that records it.
sophie.name: Sophie

scenes.narrative: Sophie asked six suppliers to quote round 2 and only three of the six have replied, though she chased the others twice. She opens the round and reads who answered and who is silent, how long each has been silent, and when she last chased them, and she wants the record to keep telling her the truth: what the answers left out, and whose move it is.
scenes.title: Half the round never answered

scenes.narrative: Sophie opens the reminder drafted for Sahel, which quotes when she last wrote, sends it from her own mailbox, and records the chase from the draft itself, so the round keeps the day.
